decision: Recommend endpoints candidate; original3identity-operation candidates remain rejected.
measurement: Construct from vector then remove all elements via front/back/erase_max. erase_max alone starts from an ascending-sorted vector to satisfy the public sorted-sequence precondition; sorting is outside the timer. Each removal observes O(1) all_prod sum, and checksum is independently computed from input prefix/suffix sums. Time includes construction, all deletions and destruction. n16 uses16384 repetitions, n1024 uses256, n262144 uses2.
coverage: Other-runtime equivalence executable covers construct/insert/erase_at/get/set/prod/apply/reverse/rotate/max_right/min_left/to_vector/copy for commutative sum and noncommutative affine composition.
notes: Both endpoints call the existing direct erase_at implementation, preserving the empty no-op and slot recycling. erase_max delegates to pop_back.
Production time seed and64bit priorities remain unchanged. Only measurement headers replace seed() identically for all variants.
All18compiler/size/operation conditions improve, with rebuilt control medians within1.4%.
No SIMD or new extension paths were added. Existing generic monoid/lazy semantics and copy exception behavior are untouched.
Online LC main does not use these endpoints. Root verifies its executable equivalence; no improvement to the1340ms online result is claimed.

The initial random-initialized erase_max trial violated its sorted precondition. All conditions were rerun after correcting the benchmark; only the updated endpoints_results.json/summary is recommended as evidence.
